articles.title: USA Wrestling Does NOT Need to Change This
articles.description: USA Wrestling is changing its World Team selection process, and Chael Sonnen has one question: why change something that's already working? Chael explains why he rejects the idea that selecting the team earlier will automatically produce better results. America's best wrestlers became elite because of the coaches, teammates and training environments they're already surrounded by. Pulling them away from that nucleus months earlier for additional national-team camps doesn't necessarily make them better prepared. Chael also challenges the entire concept of the "team." Wrestling is ultimately an individual sport, and matching USA singlets don't suddenly replace the coaches and teammates who got each athlete there. With USA Wrestling already producing tremendous results under its current leadership, Chael believes there's a strong case for leaving a successful system alone. #Wrestling #USAWrestling #OlympicWrestling #ChaelSonnen #WrestlingNews Bad Guy Inc merch now available at https://BadGuyInc.com Click here to subscribe: https://bit.ly/3FrHIPK Follow me on IG: https://bit.ly/3HY7BIE Follow me on Twitter: https://bit.ly/3tvY5J7 Follow me on Threads https://www.threads.com/@sonnench

articles.title: Why Ian Garry Can’t Be Broken #ufc
articles.description: Ian Garry has figured out something most fighters never do: He doesn't care what you think of him. Whether it's criticism of his personal life, his lifestyle, or the things he says publicly, Ian seems to have an unusual ability to take whatever people use against him and turn it into fuel. Now he's cutting a promo about veganism, and instead of trying to avoid controversy, he's leaning straight into it. That's what makes Ian Machado Garry so interesting. People have repeatedly tried to embarrass him. It hasn't worked. They've tried attacking his personal life. They've tried making him uncomfortable. They've tried turning divisive subjects into ammunition. And Ian keeps doing the same thing: He owns it. That confidence may be one of his greatest weapons. We've seen a similar strategy throughout combat sports and professional wrestling. When someone tries to turn a controversial subject into the reason the audience should hate you, sometimes the best response is simply refusing to be embarrassed by it. Ian appears to understand that. And if you're trying to become a major UFC star, that's incredibly valuable. Because whether fans love Ian Garry or can't stand him, they're talking about him. They're watching him. They're waiting for the next thing he says. And now he has an opportunity to turn all of that attention into something even bigger inside the Octagon. Against Islam Makhachev, the stakes are enormous. But Ian's confidence might be exactly what makes this matchup so fascinating. You can't embarrass a guy who refuses to be embarrassed. #IanGarry #IslamMakhachev #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #FightTalk #CombatSports #UFCNews #MMAAnalysis #IanGarryUFC

Ian Garry Was Never the Bad Guy #ufc
articles.description: Why does everybody seem to hate Ian Garry? Here’s the strange part: what exactly did he do? Ian Machado Garry has become one of those fighters people love to boo, criticize, and talk about. But when you actually look at the moments that created that reaction, a lot of them involve Ian doing the opposite of what people expected. He stood by his wife. When Khamzat Chimaev came after him, Ian didn't escalate the situation. He essentially told everybody to let the opposing team enjoy their victory and not turn it into something else. He handled it. And somehow, that didn't make people like him more. It made him more interesting. That’s the same phenomenon we've seen throughout combat sports and professional wrestling. Stone Cold Steve Austin was supposed to be the guy fans hated. Instead, they bought the shirts. They flipped him off right along with him. The Rock had the same problem. The more people tried to make him the villain, the more the audience embraced him. Ian Garry may be heading down that same road. Because love him or hate him, people are watching. And that creates a very interesting question heading into his matchup with Islam Makhachev: Is Ian actually the bigger draw? If he can turn that attention into a massive audience, he could force his way into the biggest fights in the sport. Sometimes the fighter everyone loves to hate becomes the fighter everyone has to watch. #IanGarry #IslamMakhachev #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #FightTalk #UFCNews #CombatSports #MMAFans #UFCTitleFight

articles.title: Could Islam Become the UFC GOAT? #ufc
articles.description: If Islam Makhachev beats Ian Garry, the numbers will be historic. But is that enough to make him the greatest of all time? Not by itself. A record-breaking win streak is incredible, but greatness isn't determined by one statistic. What makes Islam's case different is what happens if he continues doing it across multiple weight classes. That changes the conversation. If Islam Makhachev beats Ian Machado Garry, especially in dominant fashion, we're going to have to look at his entire résumé differently. Because Islam has already shown he can finish elite opponents quickly. He's also shown the ability to control fights for five rounds. And against Garry, there are multiple ways this could become a defining performance. What if Islam takes him down and forces an early submission? That would mean something. What if he dominates Garry for 25 minutes? That would mean something too. But there's another side to this matchup. If Garry wins, I don't believe the most likely path is simply knocking Islam out. I think his best chance could be winning rounds, managing distance, defending enough takedowns, and forcing the judges to see his work over 25 minutes. That's what makes this fight so fascinating. Islam has the tools to finish Garry. But can Garry keep the fight competitive long enough to make Islam work? And if Islam wins while adding another elite name to a historic run across two divisions, the GOAT conversation isn't going away. It may just be getting started. #IslamMakhachev #IanGarry #UFC #MMA #GOAT #UFCGOAT #ChaelSonnen #FightTalk #CombatSports #MMAAnalysis

articles.title: Alex Pereira's Stock Never Dropped
articles.description: Alex Pereira is still frustrated over the ending of his fight with Ciryl Gane, but Chael believes he's missing one important fact. Despite the controversial stoppage and losing his shot at Tom Aspinall, Pereira's standing in the sport hasn't changed. Fans still want to see him fight, the heavyweight division still sees him as a major threat, and the UFC has no shortage of blockbuster matchups waiting for him. Chael explains why Pereira's stock never dropped, why challenging Herb Dean publicly is very different from challenging the result itself, and why Alex remains one of the biggest attractions in MMA regardless of what happened at the White House event. #UFC #AlexPereira #CirylGane #TomAspinall #HerbDean #MMA #ChaelSonnen Bad Guy Inc merch now available at https://BadGuyInc.com Click here to subscribe: https://bit.ly/3FrHIPK Follow me on IG: https://bit.ly/3HY7BIE Follow me on Twitter: https://bit.ly/3tvY5J7 Follow me on Threads https://www.threads.com/@sonnench

articles.title: Islam Outstriking Ian Garry Would Be Huge #ufc
articles.description: What happens if Islam Makhachev can’t get the takedown? It might actually help him. If Islam is forced to stand with Ian Garry and starts winning those exchanges, that would tell us something we haven’t fully appreciated about his game. There’s a common narrative that Islam’s striking is his weakness. That comes largely from the one fight where he was stopped — a fight that ended with a head kick. But that doesn’t tell the whole story. Islam is a world-class grappler, but he has also developed into a far more complete striker than many people give him credit for. If he can go out there against Ian Garry, keep the fight standing when necessary, and actually outstrike a young, highly skilled striker, that would be a major statement. Especially because Garry is young, tall, rangy, and increasingly confident in his wrestling and striking. Islam Makhachev dominating him would be impressive. But dominating him on the feet? That could change the conversation entirely. And then we get to the GOAT discussion. Every major UFC event seems to produce a new “greatest fighter ever” conversation. Fans have short memories. One incredible performance happens, and suddenly the entire history of MMA gets rewritten. But Islam is different because he could eventually have the résumé to support the argument — including championship success across two weight classes. So if Islam beats Ian Garry, particularly if he does it with impressive standup exchanges, don't be surprised if the GOAT conversation gets much louder. #IslamMakhachev #IanGarry #UFC #MMA #GOAT #ChaelSonnen #FightTalk #CombatSports #UFCNews #MMAAnalysis
